summary: Players use a shared rondel of colored dice to gather resources and place them on a communal cathedral structure, fulfilling personal contracts for points while also caring about majority control on the cathedral itself. It's a tight, midweight euro with a clever mix of individual engine-building and shared-board area control.
praised: Nice tension between personal contracts and shared cathedral
Good production for a smaller box
criticised: Can feel a bit fiddly to learn at first

interaction.kind: area-majority contests on a shared structure with a shared dice market
interaction.detail: All players contribute blocks to the same central cathedral tower, and each level is scored by area majority among whoever placed there, making placement a direct contest for shared space. Dice and materials are also taken from a shared central market, so claiming a die can deny it to another player, though no action lets a player directly harm an opponent's own supply.

scoring.how_you_win: Move your die around a rondel to gather wood, stone and gold, spend them to build cathedral components for VP and fulfill contracts for bonus rewards, and contest majority on corner towers; the highest total when materials or contracts run out wins.

similar: Merv: The Heart of the Silk Road
